nodes.label: Standalone Viewer Document (index.html)
nodes.rationale: Page-filling styles live here rather than in index.css because a host page linking the stylesheet must not have its own body restyled; the poster image and the content fetch start here, before the module bundle has arrived; the engine's octree parser fetches lod-meta.json itself and ignores a prefetched response, so it is not prefetched (isPrefetchable in src/index.ts applies the same rule); the standalone document is the one place the window.* hooks belong (exposeGlobals: true).

nodes.label: sse-bootstrap Injection Seam
nodes.rationale: Single injection seam: renderViewerHtml replaces the contents of this block to supply asset urls and inline settings, so generators go through that function rather than pattern-matching the document. URL params take precedence over the bootstrap's asset URLs so an embed stays overridable per instance - except an inline settings object, which wins over ?settings= so a published experience cannot be repointed at someone else's settings file.
